TeacherProfile.title: TeacherProfile
TeacherProfile.description: Represents the profile information of a teacher using the 'Know Before You Go' application, excluding sensitive authentication data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TeacherProfile entity.

fullName.description: The full name of the teacher.

isVerifiedTeacher.description: Indicates if the teacher's profile has been verified, enabling access to exclusive features and displaying a 'Verified Teacher' badge.

familyStatus.description: The teacher's family status (e.g., 'Single', 'Couple', 'Family (2+1)', 'Family (2+2)') which impacts cost of living calculations.

ageGroup.description: The age range of the teacher (e.g., '20-30', '30-40'), used for matching. Stores a range for privacy.

qualifications.description: A list of academic or professional qualifications held by the teacher (e.g., 'PGCE', 'Master's in Education').

yearsOfExperience.description: The number of years of teaching experience the teacher has, used for matching and anonymized review display.

linkedInProfileUrl.description: URL to the teacher's LinkedIn profile, used for verification purposes.

preferredRegions.description: A list of geographic regions the teacher prefers for job searching (e.g., 'Southeast Asia', 'Middle East').

preferredCountries.description: A list of specific countries the teacher prefers for job searching (e.g., 'Thailand', 'UAE').

memberSince.description: The date and time the teacher registered their profile.

School.title: School
School.description: Represents a school listing in the application, including its core data points and descriptive information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the School entity.

name.description: The official name of the school.

description.description: A detailed description of the school.

country.description: The country where the school is located.

city.description: The city where the school is located.

websiteUrl.description: The official website URL of the school.

stabilityMetrics.description: Tactical retention and churn metrics for the institution.
